source: City of Oakley Municipal Code Ch. 9.1 (https://www.codepublishing.com/CA/Oakley/html/Oakley09/Oakley091.html); Oakley General Plan (https://www.oakleyca.gov/233/General-Plan); Oakley Housing Element 6th Cycle Draft (https://www.hcd.ca.gov/sites/default/files/docs/planning-and-community/housing-element/ccoOakleyDraftout112922.pdf); Terner Center Affordable Housing Overlay Study (https://ternercenter.berkeley.edu/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/Affordable_Housing_Overlay_Zones_Oakley.pdf)

R-20.description: Single Family Residential, Estate Lots. 20,000 sq ft minimum lot. Approx up to 2 du/ac.

R-15.description: Single Family Residential, Large Lot. 15,000 sq ft minimum lot. Approx 2.9 du/ac.

R-12.description: Single Family Residential. 12,000 sq ft minimum lot. Approx 3.6 du/ac.

R-10.description: Single Family Residential. 10,000 sq ft minimum lot. Approx 4.4 du/ac.

R-7.description: Single Family Residential, Small Lot. 7,000 sq ft minimum lot. Consistent with GP Single Family High (SH) 3.8-5.5 du/ac.

R-6.description: Single Family Residential, Compact Lot. 6,000 sq ft minimum lot. Approx 7.3 du/ac.

M-9.description: Multiple Family Residential, Low Density. Duplexes, triplexes, townhomes. Up to 9 du/ac.

M-12.description: Multiple Family Residential, Medium Density. Apartments, condos, townhomes. Up to 12 du/ac.

M-17.description: Multiple Family Residential, High Density. Apartments, condominiums. Up to 17 du/ac. Consistent with GP Multi-Family High (MH) 9.6-16.7 du/ac.

AHO.description: Affordable Housing Overlay (applied over M-9, M-12, M-17). Allows up to 24 du/ac base density for affordable housing projects.

C-1.description: Neighborhood Commercial District. Small-scale retail and service uses serving surrounding neighborhoods.

C-2.description: Community Commercial District. General retail, commercial, and service uses.

C-3.description: Highway/Service Commercial District. Auto-oriented and highway commercial uses.

BP.description: Business Park District. Office, research and development, light industrial. Up to 1.0-2.0 FAR.

P-1.description: Planned Unit Development. Density determined case-by-case per underlying general plan designation.

SP-1.description: East Cypress Corridor Specific Plan. Mixed residential and commercial; density per specific plan standards.

SP-4.description: Downtown Specific Plan. Mixed-use downtown area with varied density allowances.

A-3.description: Agricultural, Large Lot (3-acre minimum). Very low density agricultural/residential.

A-4.description: Agricultural, Estate (4-acre minimum or larger). Very low density agricultural.

AL.description: Agricultural Land. Active agricultural use, no residential development permitted.

BPL.description: Business Park - Light. Light industrial and office park uses. No residential permitted.

C.description: Commercial (general). Commercial uses. No standalone residential permitted.

CR-A.description: Commercial Residential - Area A. Mixed-use commercial and residential. Density per specific plan.

DR.description: Delta Recreation. Recreation-oriented uses in the Delta area. No residential permitted.

LI.description: Light Industrial. Manufacturing, warehousing, and light industrial uses. No residential permitted.

M-H.description: Mobile Home Residential. Mobile home and manufactured housing community. Medium density.

P.description: Public/Semi-Public. Government buildings, schools, churches, and public facilities. No residential permitted.

PR.description: Parks and Recreation. Public parks and recreational facilities. No residential permitted.

R-40.description: Single Family Residential, Very Large Lot. 40,000 sq ft minimum lot (~1 acre). Very low density.

RB.description: Recreation/Boating. Marina and water-oriented recreation uses. No residential permitted.

SP-2.description: Specific Plan 2 (Cypress Grove). Mixed residential per specific plan standards.

SP-3.description: Specific Plan 3 (Summer Lake). Mixed residential per specific plan standards.

UE.description: Urban Estate. Large-lot single-family, transitional between agricultural and suburban residential.
